title: Claim: Hyflock ransomware group says it took about 1TB from Samsung Group and encrypted internal systems
date_note: Day the claim post was first detected, per Daily Security's image caption (22 November, 22:52 KST); the article gives no date for any intrusion.
place: South Korea (Samsung Group's home country; the affiliate named in the claim is unidentified)
geo_basis: country; the article says the affected Samsung affiliate is unidentified
summary: Daily Security reports that a post attributed to the ransomware group Hyflock, listed on the tracking site ransomware.live, claims about 1TB of data was taken from Samsung Group and internal systems were encrypted. The paper says the claim is unverified and the affected affiliate is not identified. It reports no statement from Samsung confirming or denying it.
plain: A ransomware group says it stole about 1TB from Samsung Group and locked internal systems. Nothing has been confirmed, and Samsung has not been reported as responding.
exec: Unverified extortion claim against Samsung Group; no confirmation and no affected affiliate named.
impact: Unconfirmed; Daily Security says whether any Samsung affiliate was breached has not been confirmed.

evidence.quote: 약 1테라바이트(TB)의 데이터를 탈취한 뒤 시스템을 암호화했다고 주장했다

validation.note: Attacker's claim relayed by Daily Security (single publisher); the article itself says the breach is unverified. No Samsung statement found in it.

report.note: Daily Security article read in full via a fetch agent.

review.note: figure: title dropped 'about' before 1TB; summary said Hyflock posted on tracker but the tracker listed the post; evidence quote now the sentence stating about 1TB
